prompt.generated_prompt_string: Preserve the face, proportions, and external features of the attached adult model reference when one is provided. A minimalist monochrome fashion editorial triptych featuring three stacked cinematic frames. The subject is an adult man with short dark hair, light natural stubble, a white T-shirt, and a slim gold necklace. Frame 1: emotional and introspective, looking downward with a hand near the necklace, highlighting bone structure with soft Rembrandt lighting. Frame 2: a crisp profile shot, gaze directed slightly upward. Frame 3: a frontal, thoughtful portrait with relaxed shoulders and direct eye contact. The composition is clean and modern, with visual continuity across a seamless white background. Commercial magazine quality, high-end mirrorless camera, authentic skin pores, soft bokeh, and elegant understated masculinity.
